template.constraints: Match real chat: motorcycle purchase → Start New Application → mobile → state → city → address → CC → model → dealer/store → dealer code 10441 → undertaking PDF → submit. Use testdata; invalid city tests use Mumbai in Haryana etc.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user

variants.name: Motorcycle purchase - full application flow
variants.goal: Complete motorcycle purchase from mobile through dealer code, upload, and successful submission

phases.description: Request motorcycle purchase and click Start New Application
Provide valid mobile, state, city, and full address
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows CC categories (350/411/450/650 CC) or asks to choose CC category

phases.description: Select CC category, bike model, dealer vs company store, and dealer sales code 10441
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks to download/upload undertaking letter PDF

phases.description: Upload undertaking PDF, answer comment (No), confirm and submit
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms motorcycle purchase request submitted successfully

variants.name: Motorcycle purchase edge - invalid mobile rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects invalid mobile (e.g. 94621376542) then accepts valid number

phases.description: Start motorcycle flow until mobile prompt

phases.completionCriteria: Bot says number is not valid and asks for correct 10-digit number
Bot accepts mobile and asks for state or city

variants.name: Motorcycle purchase edge - wrong city no facility
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects Mumbai when state is Haryana (no facility in that city)

phases.description: Reach state and city step after valid mobile

phases.completionCriteria: Bot says this is not a city where facility is available or asks to try another location
Bot accepts city and asks for address or CC category

variants.name: Motorcycle purchase edge - city not in state
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects city that does not belong to selected state (e.g. Chandigarh when Haryana selected with strict validation)

phases.description: Provide Haryana and reach city prompt
Enter Chandigarh when state is Haryana
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects city as not valid for Haryana or asks for a listed Haryana city
phases.recoveryHint: Bot may say 'not valid city for Haryana' or 'not a city where we have facility' — either counts as rejection

variants.name: Motorcycle purchase - show more navigation
variants.goal: Use Show More on bike model list before selecting a model

phases.description: Reach bike model selection for a CC category
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows bike models with Show More or similar navigation

phases.description: Click or type Show more to see additional models
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows more bike models in the list

variants.name: Motorcycle purchase - dealer selected
variants.goal: Select Dealer (not company store) and enter dealer code 10441

phases.description: Navigate to company store vs dealer question
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks company store or dealer

phases.description: Choose Dealer and enter sales code 10441
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts dealer code and proceeds to undertaking upload or payment step

variants.name: Motorcycle purchase - cannot apply again
variants.goal: Bot blocks duplicate motorcycle application when one already exists
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
Account must already have a submitted motorcycle purchase application

phases.completionCriteria: Bot says application already exists and does not start a full new form
